players.product: 3D solder-paste / AOI inspection for SMT and advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue and operating profit grew 56% and 328% YoY; Q2 2026 revenue and operating profit rose sharply versus Q2 2025 (Q2 2025 operating profit was KRW 2,513,135,606)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 161,493M (+56% YoY), H1 operating profit KRW 24,405M (+328% YoY); Q2 revenue KRW 88,759,068,557 vs KRW 52,090,079,755; Q2 operating profit KRW 14,552,561,107 vs KRW 2,513,135,606

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report segment mix: 3D AOI revenue rose 71.1% YoY on higher sales to AI server, industrial and automotive-electronics customers; 3D SPI rose 61.6% YoY on AI server and industrial customers; the other segment (transparent-material inspection, brain-surgery robots and consumables) fell 9.6%. Filing: customer demand for its AI smart factory solution is rising and supply to global advanced-manufacturing customers is expanding; no single customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue
quarterly_data.figure: 3D AOI KRW 84,926M (+71.1% YoY, 52.6% of H1 revenue); 3D SPI KRW 63,841M (+61.6% YoY, 39.5%); other KRW 12,726M (-9.6% YoY, 7.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: products include 3D semiconductor packaging inspection equipment (Meister, Zenstar) supplied to semiconductor package and substrate makers; a government-funded 'advanced packaging optical inspection equipment' development project runs to the end of 2026; the company describes its 3D SPI as global share leader since 2006 and its 3D AOI as global leader since 2010
quarterly_data.figure: advanced packaging optical inspection project contract KRW 900M, development period 2025-04-01 to 2026-12-31

quarterly_data.signal: Subsequent event: the board resolved on 08-06-2026 to build a second plant within the existing Yeoju factory site to expand production capacity, with the investment executed in stages from August 2026 to August 2027
